1use crate::third_party::lopdf::{
2    Error, Object, Result, StringFormat,
3    encodings::{self, bytes_to_string},
4};
5
6/// Creates a text string.
7/// If the input only contains ASCII characters, the string is encoded
8/// in PDFDocEncoding, otherwise in UTF-16BE.
9pub fn text_string(text: &str) -> Object {
10    if text.is_ascii() {
11        return Object::String(text.into(), StringFormat::Literal);
12    }
13    let mut string = Vec::new();
14    encodings::encode_utf16_be(text, &mut string);
15    Object::String(string, StringFormat::Hexadecimal)
16}
17
18/// Decodes a text string.
19/// Depending on the BOM at the start of the string, a different encoding is chosen.
20/// All encodings specified in PDF2.0 are supported (PDFDocEncoding, UTF-16BE,
21/// and UTF-8).
22pub fn decode_text_string(obj: &Object) -> Result<String> {
23    let s = obj.as_str()?;
24    if s.starts_with(b"\xFE\xFF") {
25        // Detected UTF-16BE BOM
26        String::from_utf16(
27            &s[2..]
28                .chunks(2)
29                .map(|c| if c.len() == 1 { u16::from_be_bytes([c[0], 0]) } else { u16::from_be_bytes(c.try_into().unwrap()) })
30                .collect::<Vec<u16>>(),
31        )
32        .map_err(|_| Error::TextStringDecode)
33    } else if s.starts_with(b"\xEF\xBB\xBF") {
34        // Detected UTF-8 BOM
35        String::from_utf8(s.to_vec()).map_err(|_| Error::TextStringDecode)
36    } else {
37        // If neither BOM is detected, PDFDocEncoding is used
38        let mut out = String::new();
39        bytes_to_string(&encodings::PDF_DOC_ENCODING, s, &mut out)?;
40        Ok(out)
41    }
42}

44#[cfg(any())]
45mod test {
46    use crate::third_party::lopdf::{Object, StringFormat, common_data_structures::decode_text_string, encodings, text_string, writer::Writer};
47
48    #[cfg(any())]
49    fn spec_example1_encode() {
50        let input = "text‰";
51        let text_string = encodings::string_to_bytes(&encodings::PDF_DOC_ENCODING, input);
52        // let text_string = input.bytes().collect::<Vec<_>>();
53        let dict = Object::Dictionary(dictionary!(
54            "Key" => Object::String(text_string, StringFormat::Literal),
55        ));
56        let mut actual = vec![];
57        Writer::write_object(&mut actual, &dict).unwrap();
58        // "\x8B" is equivalent to the escaped version "\\213" which is used
59        // in the original example.
60        let expected = b"<</Key(text\x8B)>>";
61        assert_eq!(actual.as_slice(), expected);
62    }
63
64    #[cfg(any())]
65    fn spec_example1_decode() {
66        let input = b"<</Key(text\\213)>>";
67        let dict = crate::third_party::lopdf::parser::direct_object(input).unwrap();
68        let dict = dict.as_dict().unwrap();
69        let actual = decode_text_string(dict.get(b"Key").unwrap()).unwrap();
70        let expected = "text‰";
71        assert_eq!(&actual, expected);
72    }
73
74    #[cfg(any())]
75    fn spec_example2_encode() {
76        // Russian for "test"
77        let input = "тест";
78        // let text_string = encodings::string_to_bytes(encodings::PDF_DOC_ENCODING, input);
79        let dict = Object::Dictionary(dictionary!(
80            "Key" => text_string(input),
81        ));
82        let mut actual = vec![];
83        Writer::write_object(&mut actual, &dict).unwrap();
84        let expected = b"<</Key<FEFF0442043504410442>>>";
85        assert_eq!(actual.as_slice(), expected);
